# FXWatch Data

Auto-generated public data snapshots for the [FXWatch Terminal](https://github.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-terminal) frontend.

**Do not edit manually** — overwritten by the FXWatch backend exporter every 5 minutes.

## Endpoints (CORS-enabled, cached)

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-data/main/public/snapshot.json   ← combined
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-data/main/public/regime.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-data/main/public/currency_strength.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-data/main/public/session_heatmap.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elfastsasa1/forexwatch-data/main/public/meta.json
```

Update cadence: every 5 min.
Cost: $0.
